review: Compare neutral and complete action keys for consistent proportions, limb lengths, masses and support.
Inspect both anatomical sides for connected shoulders and hips, readable knee direction, tapered contours and clear silhouettes.
Check calf entry into each cuff, deliberate airborne ankle flexion, planted soles and clearance; inspect neckpiece and cape-root overlap.
Open every exported drawing at readable size, including intermediates and opposing half-strides; identify defects by frame and side.
Check rebuilt assets at actual game size against a ground line, including visible ink extent and attachment gaps.
For animation claims, inspect normal and slow playback, transitions, loop seam and foot travel against movement speed; static drawings alone leave motion unverified.
